cells.source: Simple keeps everyday library tasks visible and moves rarely used pages and controls out of the way. Advanced shows every navigation area. When you switch to Advanced, additional settings are enabled; each settings toolbar lets you hide them again. Switching modes changes only the interface, not your library or service configuration; use the header button or choose a mode here.
cells.target: Sederhana menjaga tugas perpustakaan sehari-hari tetap terlihat dan menyingkirkan halaman serta kontrol yang jarang digunakan. Lanjutan menampilkan semua area navigasi. Saat Anda beralih ke mode Lanjutan, pengaturan tambahan diaktifkan; setiap bilah alat pengaturan memungkinkan Anda menyembunyikannya kembali. Peralihan mode hanya mengubah antarmuka, bukan perpustakaan atau konfigurasi layanan Anda; gunakan tombol di bagian atas atau pilih mode di sini.
checks: Simple and Advanced are translated and match the visible Indonesian controls Sederhana and Mode lanjutan.
The help text preserves the settings behavior, navigation coverage, and statement that switching modes does not change library or service configuration.
